name: mortgage-anchor-forecast
description: Forward-rate projection of Israeli mortgage anchors from the Bank of Israel zero-coupon curve

scripts.test: node test/test-refresh.mjs && node test/test-wide.mjs && node test/test-json-rows.mjs && node test/test-merge.mjs
scripts.serve: node --input-type=module -e "import http from 'node:http';import fs from 'node:fs';import path from 'node:path';const t={'.html':'text/html','.json':'application/json','.csv':'text/csv','.mjs':'text/javascript'};http.createServer((q,s)=>{const f=path.join(process.cwd(),q.url==='/'?'index.html':q.url.split('?')[0]);if(!fs.existsSync(f)){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('not found');}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':t[path.extname(f)]||'text/plain'});s.end(fs.readFileSync(f));}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('http://localhost:8080'))"
